data.current_summary: Find games and their lowest listed prices
data.current_description: Pass exactly one of q, slug, slugs, steam_id, steam_ids, url. Batches take up to 50 values. Answers are cached for 15 minutes.
data.summary_suggestion: Look up game prices by name, ID, or URL
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves the lowest listed PC game key prices across SuperDuperBundle's compared stores. Accepts a single lookup method: game name query (q), game slug (slug/slugs), Steam app ID (steam_id/steam_ids), or store URL (url). Batch queries support up to 50 values per request. Returns game details including lowest price, store name, last checked timestamp, and SuperDuperBundle comparison page URL. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Requires proper attribution and linking of prices to the game's URL per API terms.
